sections.title: What it is
sections.body: Advantage adds a d6; disadvantage subtracts a d6.

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: Use when the fiction gives a clear edge or obstacle.

sections.title: Step by step
items: Use when the fiction gives a clear edge or obstacle.
Roll a d6 and add it; disadvantage subtracts it.
Return to the fiction with the concrete result, cost, or benefit.
